title_en: Chinese Companies (12/20): Gree, Thirty Years of Focusing on Air Conditioners
note_en: The frame 以……著称 means "to be known for ...": 董明珠以强硬的管理风格著称 "Dong is known for her tough management style." Where English puts "for" after the verb, Chinese puts 以 plus the quality first and ends with the verb 著称. It is written style; in speech you would hear 出名 instead (她的管理风格很强硬，很出名).
